column2: [intro]
You’re like a butterfly, indecisive and light,
Blowing with the wind, never picking a fight.
Always hesitant, torn between the routes,
Your life’s a game of hopscotch, no doubts.
Play with your choices, you’re the one in control,
Like a tightrope walker, you flirt with the role.
Navigating endless possibilities, no end in sight,
Let fate guide you through every turn and flight.
You’re a tightrope walker with no safety net,
You love to shuffle the cards with no regret.
In your hands, the world’s a playground,
But beware, time is ticking all around.
Play with your choices, you feel so free,
But watch out, the clock’s ticking on your spree.
Between black and white, the rainbow's unclear,
You might get lost in this grand atmosphere.
[ solo ]

Like a tightrope walker, you flirt with the land.
